Reading pages.Homepage.php: Redirects an entry’s legacy Homepage route to its view.
Reading pages.chapterify.php: Prepares an entry and its children for chapter-oriented presentation.
Reading pages.image_src.php: Redirects the legacy image source route to the image browser.
Reading pages.image.php: Browses and paginates an entry’s images.
Reading pages.images.php: Redirects the plural legacy route to the image browser.
Reading pages.index.php: Redirects the legacy index script to the entry view.
Reading pages.router.php: Redirects the legacy router script to the entry view.
Reading pages.search.php: Searches entries and displays matching records.
Reading pages.searchlink.php: Searches entries and prepares matching links with their context.
Reading pages.shop.php: Redirects the legacy shop script to the entry view.
Reading pages.view.php: Displays, browses, and indexes entries, including dictionary views and votes.

Editing.convertspelling.php: Converts submitted text between British and American spelling.
Editing.importer.php: Accepts structured imports and prepares entries and uploads for saving.
Editing.modify.php: Adds, edits, and manages entry records.
Editing.transfer.php: Searches for a target parent and moves an entry to it.
Editing.upload.php: Redirects the legacy upload route to the add-entry form.

Accounts.install.php: Redirects the legacy install route to login.
Accounts.register.php: Redirects the legacy registration route to login.
Accounts.signup.php: Redirects the legacy signup route to login.
Accounts.user-panel.php: Shows the signed-in user’s submissions and their status.
Accounts.user.php: Displays the user entry point and handles its login action.
Accounts.users.php: Lists users and supports viewing or exporting user information.
Accounts.wp-login.php: Redirects the WordPress-style login route to GGCMS login.

Formats and feeds.feed.php: Redirects the legacy feed route to news.
Formats and feeds.new.php: Redirects the legacy new-content route to news.
Formats and feeds.news.php: Renders recent entries and feed documentation.
Formats and feeds.robots.php: Builds robots directives and their browsable representation.
Formats and feeds.sitemap.php: Renders the site’s sitemap index and paginated URL lists.
Formats and feeds.style.php: Renders the stylesheet associated with a requested style and action.

Admin and status.datautilities.php: Identifies duplicate keys in submitted lists.
Admin and status.dbstatus.php: Provides database diagnostics and lookup-list maintenance.
Admin and status.languageutils.php: Cleans and transforms lists of words and other language data.
Admin and status.master-c.php: Runs specialized administrative content and image maintenance.
Admin and status.ping.php: Checks a URL through the administrative ping tools.
Admin and status.redirect.php: Provides redirect handling for sign-in and secure connections.

Admin and status.social.php: Provides Instagram sign-in and posting actions.
Admin and status.systemstatus.php: Displays system and runtime diagnostic views.
Admin and status.userstatus.php: Reviews comments and saves moderation changes.

Static pages.about.php: Describes the site or current collection.
Static pages.codeofconduct.php: Displays the site’s code of conduct.
Static pages.hackers.php: Displays credits for people who built or contributed to the site.
Static pages.play.php: Provides word search, crossword, guessing, and typing games.
Static pages.pronounce.php: Looks up pronunciations and displays a result.
Static pages.return-policy.php: Displays the site’s return policy when enabled.
Static pages.suggest.php: Displays and handles the suggestion form.
Static pages.terms.php: Displays the site’s terms of service.

overlay.randomwords.php: Configures the random-word source and presentation.

formats.DAISY: Produces DAISY digital talking book output.
formats.HTML: Provides browser page rendering and HTML text formatting.
